caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated object, centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a handmade rope or cord, consisting of various materials and textures. On the left end, there is a loop formed by two brownish tan leather straps, tied around a thicker, cylindrical section that is wrapped in a reddish-brown textured material. The central part of the object is a dark brown and tan twisted cord, wrapped and segmented at intervals with lighter, tan colored bindings. Small tufts of dark bristly hair-like fibers protrude from both sides of these bindings in the twisted cord segment. The right end of the object tapers and is finished with another segment of reddish-brown material, secured by another lighter tan wrapping, with the very end terminating in a frayed, narrow tip. The object is horizontally oriented and roughly centered on the page, with the label “Honda o Quisera” written in small letters to the lower right of the drawing.
title: Quirt
